archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: step 4 COUNT of ALARM_PIPELINE_V1 section 1 (fires, waves and coins per Sep-Dec month; no outcome read), and the CLEAN of a run's decided jobs
question: How do I queue my COUNT job, or the CLEAN of my finished and decided jobs, so that the runner runs it from the release folder?

commands.name: count
commands.does: checks everything, then queues one COUNT job (up to 3 definitions); with --dry it only prints the filled job

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: --job-settings
args.meaning: the settings file of the machine that runs the job (the job runner's), when it is another one (default: --settings)

args.name: RUN
args.meaning: the run tag: the folder RESEARCH_ROOT/ALARM_DESIGN/runs/<RUN>; the seat is the part before _

args.name: KIND
args.meaning: COUNT

args.name: IDEA
args.meaning: the idea: capitals and digits, starting with a letter; its claim file runs/IDEAS_CLAIMED/<RUN>_<IDEA>.txt must exist

args.name: ITEMS
args.meaning: V=ideas/<IDEA>/defs/<V>.json, comma separated, at most 3; each window must cover 20250910 to 20260430

args.name: --queue
args.meaning: a queue Q_V1..Q_V21 (default: the first empty one)

args.name: --behind
args.meaning: allow a queue that holds only your own jobs (your 3rd job then waits there)

args.name: --dry
args.meaning: every check, then print the filled job; claims, writes and queues nothing

commands.writes: with --dry: nothing. Without: the job twin RUN/jobs/<N>_judge_<SEAT>_COUNT_<IDEA>.job.sh, one RUNS row, the job in <RUNNER_QUEUES>/<Q_Vn>/IN. The job then writes RUN/receipts/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/ (STAGES.tsv, COUNT_<V>.tsv, FIRST20_<V>.tsv, DISK.tsv, SHA16.txt, det logs) and SCRATCH/work_<RUN>/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr. No --settings; a key it needs is empty (RESEARCH_ROOT, RUNNER_QUEUES, RUNNER_ALLOC, SCRATCH, and for the job PYTHON and LAB_DAYS); a bad run tag, kind or name; no run folder; the idea not claimed; a definition outside ideas/<IDEA>/, missing, or whose window misses 20250910-20260430; more than 3 definitions; your job budget (2 jobs, 3 with --behind); no empty queue; SCRATCH free under 60,000 MB plus WRITES_MB; the run's uncleaned scratch over 10,000 MB; a template or reg_append_v1.py whose sha16 changed; a placeholder left; a refused word; bash -n failed; the allocator failed

dry_runs.prints: DRY RUN OK: AD1_20261029 COUNT FLOWX V1 on Q_V1

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr: as count, and a job not of this kit or not in your RUNS, still queued or running, already in a queued CLEAN, with no SHA16.txt, already cleaned, still read by a queued job (--from-job), a GRADE or ENTRY variant not decided, a COUNT or MONTH job with no POSTMORTEMS row

commands.name: grade-month
commands.does: queues one GRADE job (1 to 3 variants on Sep-Dec 2025; JOB_GRADE_V7, the chain v2_0_2) or one MONTH job (the Jan-Apr 2026 reads of a decided variant, --from-job <its GRADE job>; JOB_MONTH_V7, the chain v2_2_2); with --dry it only prints the filled job. A variant is graded once: a change is a new variant

rules: the only way a KIT_V5 agent queues a job: COUNT, GRADE (JOB_GRADE_V7, the chain v2_0_2 with the grader rel1, since ALARM_V1_3), ENTRY (JOB_ENTRY_V6, since ALARM_V1_2), MONTH (JOB_MONTH_V7, the chain v2_2_2 with the aw1 rel1 editions, since ALARM_V1_4) and CLEAN
run --dry first; it claims, writes and queues nothing
never deletes, never overwrites (the twin is opened new; IN is written as .part then renamed)
reads no market data; the job reads code only inside the release folder (@@ALARM@@) and checks each pin's sha16 there
the quiet window is gone (the owner 30 Oct 2026 23:32 Berlin): jobs can be queued at any hour

outputs.where: <RESEARCH_ROOT>/ALARM_DESIGN/runs/<RUN>/registers/RUNS.tsv: one row per queued job, at queue time
RUN/receipts/<N>_<KIND>_<IDEA>/STAGES.tsv: one line per stage of the job, written as it runs
RUN/receipts/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/COUNT_<V>.tsv: fires, waves and coins per Sep-Dec month
RUN/receipts/<N>_COUNT_<IDEA>/FIRST20_<V>.tsv: the header and first 20 fires of the detection, every detect.py column (coin and t first)
